item.title: Developer files lawsuit against Eagle Mountain City over misuse of rodeo grounds, demands land back
item.description: An Eagle Mountain developer filed a lawsuit against Eagle Mountain City on Tuesday, claiming the city has misused property, specifically the rodeo grounds at Pony Express Memorial Park, deeded to them back in 2002.

item.title: Washington County leaders, residents react after Northern Corridor Project halted
item.description: ABC4 spoke with a Washington County leader and residents who have supported the Northern Corridor project, after the Utah Department of Transportation had to immediately stop construction on the project due to a preliminary injunction.

item.title: Orem man charged with kidnapping, violently assaulting coworker
item.description: An Orem man has been arrested and charged for allegedly physically and sexually assaulting a coworker on two occasions. Documents say he strangled the victim so severely that it caused some brain damage.

item.title: One person critically injured after crash on Highway 59 near Hurricane
item.description: One person was critically injured after an accident on Highway 59 in Washington County.

item.title: One critically injured after being struck by a vehicle in Kearns
item.description: One person is critically injured after being struck by a vehicle near 5400 S and 4600 W in Kearns on Wednesday evening.

item.title: Wayne County Sheriff's Office tells residents to stay home, take extra precautions due to 'recent incidents'
item.description: The Wayne County Sheriff's Office is advising residents to take extra precautions and stay home Wednesday night if possible due to 'recent incidents.'

item.title: Prices on many everyday items could go up due to conflict with Iran, University of Utah professor says
item.description: As gas prices in Utah have spiked because of the conflict in Iran, Utahns are worrying about the economic impact this is going to have, and unfortunately, many other prices are likely to go up.

item.title: 'We just want to get home': Utah residents stranded in Dubai speak on ongoing conflict
item.description: Several Utah residents who have been stranded in Dubai amid military strikes spoke on their experiences and efforts to return home.

item.title: Rep. Celeste Maloy introduces resolution to reject Biden-era management plan of Grand Staircase-Escalante Monument
item.description: Rep. Celeste Maloy introduced a joint resolution to reject a Biden-era plan for Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument and return management to a 2020 Trump-era plan that was developed with input from locals. Environmentalists are pushing back.

item.title: Tracy Aviary volunteers look after birds
item.description: In the heart of Salt Lake City’s Liberty Park you’ll find an oasis- the Tracy Aviary. For more than 80 years Tracy Aviary has been leading the way in conservation and volunteers help make the work possible.
